tei:div.tei:p: mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang gi dpe tshogs bsdu sgrig las mi'i mtshan tho/spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma dang*/

'gro 'dul rdo rje/ bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gzhon pa dang*/ gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/ gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bsdu sgrig pa/ thub bstan 'od zer/ zla ba bstan 'dzin/ dpyid sa dpal bzang*/ dkon mchog bsam gtan/ shes rab bzang po/ zhu dag pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ karma bde legs/ dkon mchog bsam gtan/ rgyab shog bzo skrun jus 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang*/ lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chos mtsho/ par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chos mtsho/ byams pa chos sgron/ bstan 'dzin/ bsod nams tshe sgron sogs dpal brtsegs glog klad las byed pa rnams/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi gsung chos skor/rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi mdzad rnams mdor bsdus/ -PAGE 8--PAGE 7-
